function: Define a tendon profile along the length of elements. Create the tendon profile relative to its own coordinate system, which will then be inserted relative to the elements. Note 1 Tendon placement can be simplified by copying, rotating and sloping tendon profiles. Note 2 Tendon properties can be changed at the Tendon Profile location in Works Tree.
menu_path: From the Main Menu select [Load] tab > [Type : Prestress] > [Prestress Loads] group > [ Tendon Profile]
note:
x Axis Rot. Angle must be entered between -85 and +85 degrees.

Projection
The tendon profile placed in the table is projected on the plane, which is rotated about TCS x-axis by the Angle.

Offset : Tendon Offset is defined in the Element Coordinate System (ECS).

y : Distance by which the tendon profile is moved in the ECS y-axis direction

z : Distance by which the tendon profile is moved in the ECS z-axis direction
